description: This file defines the EntityEcaSetField class, which provides functionality to evaluate and format field values within the context of entity event condition-action (ECA) sets in the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for expanding string values, applying various formatting options, and manipulating the context map based on entity configuration.

classes.name: EntityEcaSetField
classes.description: A final class that represents a configuration for setting and formatting a field value within an entity's event condition-action framework, including methods for evaluating and formatting the value based on configuration parameters.

methods.name: EntityEcaSetField
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the entity field configuration from an XML Element, extracting attributes like 'field-name', 'env-name', 'value', and 'format'.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates the value for the field based on the context map, performing string expansion and applying formatting rules.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Applies specific formatting rules to the expanded string value based on the 'format' attribute, including case transformations, appending, hash code, numeric conversions, and entity name transformations.

methods.name: getFieldName
methods.description: Returns the name of the field being set.

methods.name: getRValue
methods.description: Returns the raw value or environment name associated with the setting for use in configurations.
